title: Thai Coconut Cream Pastry Bites
description: A fusion of Thai flavors with a crispy pastry crust, these bite-sized treats are perfect for snacking. They're also surprisingly easy to make!
instructions: Roll out the pastry to a thickness of 3mm (1/8 inch).
Cut out squares of pastry, about 7cm (3 inches) per side.
Spoon a small amount of coconut cream onto one half of each square.
Drizzle a little algerian creamy sauce on top of the coconut cream.
Fold the other half of the pastry square over to form a triangle, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastry with a little egg and sprinkle with sugar.
Place the pastry bites on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Allow to cool for a few minutes before serving.
